d:
This is Mechuka in Arunachal Pradesh! And I re-visited after 5 long years. And if you're an Indian, you'll need an Inner Line Permit (ILP) to get here -
You can get the inner line permit online or at the border on working days.
And if you are a foreigner, you'll need to apply for a Protected Area Permit (PAP)
Mind you, the road journey to this place is really long, and you'll have to take a break at Aalo in between. For which I recommend Reyi Homestay.
We shot a music video in Mechuka and this vlog is a full description of how it went and all the best moments worth recounting.
